newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.19 pct (6.06) at Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.19 pct (6.06) at Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 2.5 trillion lire buyback of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 6.19 percent compared with 6.06 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.26 percent against 6.28 percent at the previous buyback offer for 3.0 trillion lire on June 26 when the central bank repurchased only 2.884 trillion lire of bills.
The Bank said it received 20 bids of which 10 were met in full and one in part.
